title: Three-step boundary operation
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Gamma$ be a symbol alphabet, let $x$ be an input word, and let $i$ be one of $k$ work tapes. For any symbol $b\in\Gamma$ and configuration $d$ whose state is $0$, the boundary machine reaches after three steps the configuration with state $3$, with $b$ written on tape $i$ at the cell one left of its initial head position and that head moved one cell to the right. State $3$ is not reached at any earlier time, and through time three the selected head stays between one cell left and one cell right of its initial position while every other work-tape head remains fixed.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $d$ on $k$ tapes with states in $\mathrm{Fin}(4)$
